timestamp.description: A continuously increasing identifier of the sampling time registered by the device.

center_coordinate_left.description: [NEW] 3D coordinate representing the position of the left eye center in the coordinate system and unit specified in the corresponding metadata.

center_coordinate_right.description: [NEW] 3D coordinate representing the position of the right eye center in the coordinate system and unit specified in the corresponding metadata.

optical_axis_left.description: [NEW] 3D vector representing the optical or pupillary axis formed by joining the eye ball center to pupil center of the left eye.

optical_axis_right.description: [NEW] 3D vector representing the optical or pupillary axis formed by joining the eye ball center to pupil center of the right eye.

corneal_reflections.description: List of detected corneal reflection (glint) coordinates for purkinjee based eyey-trackers.

confidence.description: [NEW] confidence measure for the eye ball predictions ranging from a 0 (0%) to 1 (100%)
